### Item 1 — what the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Simulator (Ignatius Feldmann-Okafor, collections manager, Ostrander Valley Auto Credit, Inc.) opens: who he is, the company, and that he wants "to pay off invoice OV-526061 completely"; he asks what it takes to clear it. Identifiers on request: phone 5745555816, EIN last4 5947. If asked about other invoices: only OV-526061 today. If told something must be added to the invoice first: "understood and they may go ahead". He pays OV-526061 himself for exactly the quoted amount once the instrument is handed over. Object (invoice OV-526061), timing (today), boundary (that one invoice, in full) and authorisation (he pays himself) are clear; the simulator is passive and only runs the handed-over user tool.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse

Act now (after the prerequisite write). Grounds:
- `find_client_service_requests` → "No client service requests found", so no termination notice is on record; past_due_invoice_payoff_payment: "A creditor client may pay off a past-due fee invoice ... that is accruing late charges with one payment it makes itself, naming the invoice, on an agreement with no termination notice on record."
- OV-526061 is accruing late charges: invoice date 2026-07-07; Preferred due 30 days + grace 10 days (invoicing_and_late_charge_terms) → late-charge start 2026-08-16; 2026-10-20 is later (fee_invoicing_and_payments 3.1–3.3), and a late charge already stands on it (15.19 on 2026-09-16).
- Gate (same doc): "A payoff figure for a past-due invoice is not quoted until the invoice carries a late charge for every full calendar month it has stayed unpaid after its late-charge start." Full months after 2026-08-16 by 2026-10-20: to 2026-09-16 and to 2026-10-16 = 2; late charges on OV-526061 = 1. The gate fails now and is resolvable on the spot.
- The agreement is in placement_hold (fees_past_due); no visible rule makes a payoff depend on agreement status.

### Item 4 — scored parameters

**(a) The missing month's late charge on OV-526061** (late_charge_amount_computation + factor docs), handling date 2026-10-20.
- Unpaid amount = 2846.70 − 1010.00 − 0 = 1836.70.
- Baseline: Preferred late-charge percent 1.5 × 1836.70 = 27.5505; minimum 5.00; higher → 27.5505 → fall-back **27.55** (definite, different).
- Invoice-age step (invoice_age_late_charge_step): age 2026-07-07 → 2026-10-20 = 105 days → 100–149 → +0.25 point. Found from: the invoice entry date.
- Pre-collect pack rate (precollect_pack_payment_late_charge_rate): program naming this agreement; purchase 2025-03-04 → paid 2025-03-27 = 23 days ≤ the pack's invoice due days 30 (First Notice 300-Unit Program, flat-fee invoice terms) → paid within; pack age 2025-03-04 → 2026-10-20 = 19 whole months ≥ 12 → −0.50 point. Found from: the flat-fee program record (purchase_date, paid_date, variant).
- Monthly rate = 1.5 + 0.25 − 0.50 = 1.25 percent; percentage charge = 1836.70 × 1.25 % = 22.95875.
- Minimum combination (late_charge_minimum_combination): late charges on the agreement's other invoices in the 12 months ending 2026-10-20 (after 2025-10-20): 2026-01-16, 2026-05-14 = 2 (2025-10-15 outside; the 15.19 on OV-526061 itself not counted) → percentage charge plus the minimum: 22.95875 + 5.00 = 27.95875. Found from: `client_late_charge_assessed` entries on other invoice numbers.
- Reliefs/adjustment, added into one share:
  - part-payment relief (late_charge_part_payment_relief): 1010.00 / 2846.70 = 0.3548 → at least 0.25, below 0.5 → 10 percent (found from the fee payment carrying OV-526061);
  - tenure relief (late_charge_tenure_relief): 2023-05-01 → 2026-10-20 = 41 whole months → 15 percent (found from the agreement's effective date);
  - legal standing adjustment (late_charge_legal_standing_adjustment): legal agreement naming this agreement is active; cost deposit 1315.00 ≥ Client-Advanced minimum deposit balance 1000.00 → 10 percent relief (found from the legal agreement record).
  - share = 0.35; charge = 27.95875 × 0.65 = 18.1731875 → **18.17**.
- Note on order: the reliefs reduce "the charge" (late_charge_tenure_relief: "A charge of 30.00 USD with a tenure relief of 15 percent ... is 25.50 USD"; legal doc: "late charge before any relief or adjustment 20.00 USD"), i.e. the figure after the percentage/minimum combination; the alternative of adding the minimum after the reliefs (22.95875 × 0.65 + 5.00 = 19.92) is not what the visible "charge" wording describes.

**(b) Payoff of OV-526061** (past_due_invoice_payoff_amount + factor docs), payoff day 2026-10-20, after (a) is booked.
- Baseline: unpaid 1836.70 + every late charge on the invoice (15.19 + 18.17) = 1870.06 → fall-back **1870.06** (with the late charge at its own fall-back: 1836.70 + 15.19 + 27.55 = 1879.44). Definite, different.
- Late-charge inclusion (payoff_late_charge_inclusion): most recent late charge dated 2026-10-20 (booking is "dated the day of booking"), 0 days ≤ 10; invoice carries 2 ≤ 3 → only the most recent enters: 18.17.
- Concessions on the entering late charges, added into one share (cap 1):
  - collection volume (payoff_collection_volume_concession): collections booked after 2026-07-20 through 2026-10-20: 2310.00 + 1150.00 + 2940.00 + 1860.00 = 8260.00 (reversal not subtracted) → 10 percent;
  - legal volume (payoff_legal_volume_concession): suits filed after 2025-10-20: 2026-02-20, 2026-07-09 = 2 → 10 percent;
  - payment record (payoff_payment_record_concession): fee payments after 2026-04-20 through 2026-10-20: 05-04, 05-22, 06-03, 07-02, 08-25, 09-03 = 6 → 50 percent;
  - returned payment (payoff_returned_payment_concession): returned-payment reversals after 2026-07-20: 2026-09-08 = 1 → 5 percent.
  - share = 0.75; entering late charges 18.17 × 0.25 = 4.5425.
- Payoff = 1836.70 + 4.5425 = 1841.2425 → **1841.24**.
- Factor findability: each factor document was reached from record words — invoice date (age step), flat-fee program purchase/paid dates (pack rate), other-invoice `client_late_charge_assessed` rows (minimum combination), fee payment on the invoice (part payment), effective_date (tenure), legal agreement status + cost_deposit_balance (legal standing), `client_collection_booked` (collection volume), `legal_suit_filed` (legal volume), `client_fee_payment_received` (payment record), `client_collection_reversed ... payment_returned` (returned payment), late-charge entry dates/count on the invoice (inclusion). No computation document hinted at a variation.

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 the payoff of OV-526061 (root, customer's own write); P2 booking the missing month's late charge on OV-526061 (agent write). P1 waits on P2; order P2 then P1.

Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (past_due_invoice_payoff_payment, "When a payoff figure is quoted"): "A payoff figure for a past-due invoice is not quoted until the invoice carries a late charge for every full calendar month it has stayed unpaid after its late-charge start." State form; no tool or action named. The same document defines the full calendar month.
- Record check: late-charge start 2026-08-16 (from the invoice entry date and the Preferred due/grace figures); full months completed by 2026-10-20: two (to 09-16, to 10-16); late-charge entries carrying OV-526061: one. State does not hold; exactly one month lacks its charge.
- Finding the write: searching "late charge" / "past-due fee invoice" reaches invoice_late_charge_booking: "Booking a month's late charge adds one late-charge entry, dated the day of booking and tied to the named invoice ... Each booking is one month's charge on one invoice." That write brings the state about; the amount comes from late_charge_amount_computation and its factor documents.
- P2's documents state no prerequisite of their own. No further hop.

Closest alternatives excluded:
- "Do only what was asked" (quote 1836.70 + 15.19 = 1851.89 now): excluded by "as long as any full calendar month the invoice has stayed unpaid after its late-charge start is without its late charge on that invoice, there is no payoff figure for the invoice."
- Booking two charges (counting a third month): the third full month would end 2026-11-16, not yet complete.
- Late charge at 27.55 or "greater of" the minimum: excluded by the age-step, pack-rate, minimum-combination and relief documents read against the records.
- All late charges entering the payoff (33.36): excluded by payoff_late_charge_inclusion row 1 (≤ 10 days, ≤ 3 charges).
- Paying other invoices or the whole fees owed: excluded — the payoff is "the past-due fee invoice the client names", and no termination notice is on record so the closing settlement does not apply.

No contamination: none. Residual note (not a defect claim at this stage): two factor documents name figures that are stated only in sibling product corpora (the pack's invoice due days; the legal programme's cost deposit minimum balance); both were reachable at runtime.
